card.name: Second digit after a leading 1
card.fires_on: The second digit (often 2 or 0) of a number written with a leading 1, such as 12, 10 or 120. Also the word Eight in a book title. It mostly appears before units like months, weeks or mg.

modes.label: Second digit after 1
modes.description: A digit that follows an initial 1 in a two- or three-digit number, often before a unit or noun.
modes.example: Second course: 12 mg/day on 3 consecutive days 1<<2>> months after first treatment course.

modes.label: Number word in a title
modes.description: The word Eight starting a book title phrase before a noun.
modes.example: In the book,<< Eight>> Great Ideas, I talk about using music

card.writes: It seems to favor word endings and time units such as months, but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on the second digit of numbers starting with 1, like the 2 in 12 or the 0 in 10.
